hints.title: Rolling Position History
hints.text: Maintain only the two most recent indices seen for each unique value.

hints.title: Instantaneous Span Check
hints.text: When a value appears for the third (or subsequent) time at index i, candidate distance is i - second_last[x].

hints.title: History Shift
hints.text: Shift the previous occurrence into the second-previous position and record current index as latest.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: U: number of unique values in nums
complexity.notes: Streaming single pass maintaining last two appearances per value.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Storing full unbounded occurrence lists consumes more memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(U) memory bounded by unique elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Optimize index memory to only store the latest two indices per unique key.
